title: Cyberpunk Cheshire Cat
description: A massive biomechanical cat with purple and gold striped fur strides across a swirling vortex of colorful energy. Its large green mechanical eyes contain an entire detailed cyberpunk cityscape with tiny figures and vehicles, while its body features exposed brass gears, pipes, and glowing green circuitry. Below, a dark industrial city with smoking factories and vintage cars is visible under a stormy sky.
